ideas.title: Investigating the Hudson River Tunnel Funding Freeze
ideas.description: A deeper dive into the $16 billion funding freeze for the Hudson River tunnel project and its implications
ideas.angle: Following the money and exploring potential corruption or mismanagement
questions: What are the reasons behind the funding freeze?
How will this impact the project and related entities?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential corruption or mismanagement in the Trump administration's handling of the funding freeze. Investigating the reasons behind the freeze and its impact on the project could lead to further discoveries.

ideas.title: The Impact of Minnesota Federal Prosecutors Quitting
ideas.description: Exploring the implications of multiple federal prosecutors quitting amid the DOJ's response to the Renee Good shooting
ideas.angle: Investigating the reasons behind the resignations and potential impacts on ongoing cases
questions: What are the reasons behind the prosecutors' resignations?
How will this impact ongoing cases in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential issues with the DOJ's handling of cases or office politics. Investigating the reasons behind the resignations could lead to further discoveries.
